question: What is node #115's Find delegate vtable family: which vtable does each delegate class use, what does each delegate-interface slot (0x10..0x98) do, and how does find_entry dispatch through the delegate?

value_struct.note: The matcher node's +0x28 object pointer (the delegate) is a different +0x28 from this value struct's +0x28 kind field; keep the two apart.

interface_slots.contract: If the option name is exactly "id" (length 2, bytes 0x6469), return the delegate's own name (its slot-0x78 string) and a zeroed Status; otherwise forward to Configurable's slot 0x10 (0x6099030).

Return 1 when the value's +0x2c byte is <= 1, when out == delegate, or (return 0) when the delegate is null. Otherwise compare the delegate's name with this object's name via slot 0x78; on mismatch rewrite the option name to "id" (0x441b15), then forward to Configurable's slot 0x18 (0x60996a0) when the value's +0x2c byte is > 2, else return 1.
Initialize a std::string at rdi: pointer rdi+0x10, length 0, NUL at +0x10. Returns rdi.

interface_slots.role: parse/apply a list of (name, value) records
interface_slots.contract: Walk 0x30-byte records from the range in rsi. For each record copy the name (SSO-aware) and the 0x20-byte value struct, then walk its +0x18 entry chain; for each entry materialize five sub-values through the +0x40/+0x60/+0x80/+0xa0/+0xc0 copy function pointers (tag 2). When the HIGH dword of the entry's +0xd0 qword, minus 4, is > 1 (unsigned; a high dword of 0..3 wraps and also passes) and the 0x40 bit of the byte at +0xd9 is clear and (the materialized +0xa0 sub-value's first qword is non-null or the LOW dword of the +0xd0 qword, minus 0x15, is <= 1 unsigned), call worker 0x60b9e00 (unmodeled) with the built value and copy the returned Status to the out parameter; then tear down the sub-values through their slot-0x00 pointers with code 3. When +0xc0 is null the binary skips materializing that sub-value and jumps to a second, identical gate site.

interface_slots.role: parse/apply a list of (name, value) records (worker 2)
interface_slots.contract: Same record walk and sub-value materialization as slot 0x28, but the worker is 0x60b9f50 (unmodeled, six arguments) and the kind gate has no 0x40 flag-byte check: the worker fires when (HIGH dword of the +0xd0 qword - 4) > 1 unsigned and (the raw +0xc0 function pointer is non-null or (LOW dword of the +0xd0 qword - 0x15) <= 1 unsigned). When +0xc0 is null the binary skips materializing it and jumps to a second gate site that runs the same predicate without the +0xc0 branch.

interface_slots.role: resolve an option name to a field
interface_slots.contract: Call the shared resolver 0x60958c0: it scans the 0x30-byte (name, +0x20 field) record array at *(rdi+0x08)..*(rdi+0x10) for the name in rsi (length then memcmp, SSO-aware) and returns the matching record's +0x20 field, or null. If the resolver returns non-null, return it. Otherwise call this object's slot 0x88 (the wrapped object) and, when non-null, tail-jump to the wrapped object's slot 0x38; return null when there is no wrapped object.
Write a zeroed 16-byte Status (u32 0, u16 0, u64 0) into *(rdi) and return rdi. Byte-identical copies at 0x5fcc0e0 and 0x5fcc100.
The merge host every slot-0x48 override calls first (see RE-001-find-family-merge-115, #3560). It returns a Status in *(rdi); the overrides return early when its first byte is non-zero.

When the value kind byte (+0x04) is 0, forward (name, value) to worker 0x60bedc0 (unmodeled). When kind != 0 and the changeable flag at name+0xb1 is set, copy the value struct (shared_ptr refcounted) and call 0x60bedc0. When kind != 0 and the flag is clear, build the error string "Option not changeable: " (0x4341c2) + name and report it through 0x61cf670 (unmodeled) with code 4. Always returns the out Status.
Call kind validator 0x60bf980 (unmodeled); if it accepts, return 1. Otherwise call 0x60bf7c0 (unmodeled); if it rejects too, blank the target name string (replace with ""). Always returns 1.

Call the delegate's slot 0x78 for its name. When the value kind (+0x28) is 1 or the delegate name is empty, compose the out string as <options name> + "id" + "=" + <delegate name> + <value name>; when the delegate name string is also empty, assign the delegate name directly. Otherwise forward to Configurable's slot 0x60 (0x60985e0) and copy its output.

Call the delegate's slot 0x70 (Name()); if the input name starts with that name followed by '.', strip the prefix (name + '.') and return the remainder as the out string; if Name() is null, throw std::logic_error. Otherwise fall back to Configurable's slot 0x68 (0x6095a60), a std::string copy into the out string.

Return the class's name as a const char*: "" for Env, "BasicStatistics" for StatisticsImpl, "CompositeEnv" for CompositeEnvWrapper, "DefaultClock" for PosixClock, "PosixEnv" for PosixEnv, "MockEnv" for MockEnv, "TimeEmulatedSystemClock" for EmulatedSystemClock. SystemClockWrapper's slot 0x70 is NULL: calling Name() on it would crash.
Call the delegate's slot 0x70 (Name()) and assign the returned C string into the sret std::string at rdi through 0x5d32940 (unmodeled). Returns rdi.

Return 1 when the input string matches this object's Name() (slot 0x70) or its NickName() (slot 0x90) by length then memcmp; else 0. MockEnv and CompositeEnvWrapper override it (0x5fd6240): return 1 when the input is exactly "CompositeEnv" (length 12), else tail-jump to the canonical 0x5d2e770.
Env returns 0 (no wrapped object). SystemClockWrapper returns *(obj+0x20); MockEnv returns *(obj+0x48); StatisticsImpl returns *(obj+0x28). Slot 0x38 forwards through this object's slot 0x38.
Return the class's nickname as a const char*: "" for Env, "PosixClock" for PosixClock, "DefaultEnv" for PosixEnv.

CompositeEnv/PosixEnv/MockEnv (0x5fd5a00): take the object at the 2nd argument's +0x28; when its slot-0x98 is the terminal stub 0x5fcc240 (GOT 0x64ed8b0) write a zeroed Status into *(rdi), else call that slot-0x98. SystemClockWrapper (0x5d4d490): walk the +0x20 chain, comparing each level's slot-0x98 against the GOT slot 0x64ecf80 (0x5d4d490 itself), 10 levels unrolled, then tail-jump to the innermost slot-0x98. Env (0x5fcc0e0): zeroed Status. StatisticsImpl (0x6070490): run the +0x38 field's pre-hook 0x60d5230 (unmodeled), call core 0x6070430 (unmodeled), run the +0x38 post-hook 0x60d52f0 (unmodeled), return the core result. PosixClock (0x5fe1540): gettimeofday, return tv_sec * 1000000 + tv_usec (microseconds since the epoch). EmulatedSystemClock (0x60259e0): when the flag byte at +0x48 is clear, call the wrapped clock's (at +0x20) slot 0x98; return that result plus the offset at +0x40 (0 when the flag is set).

override_notes.SystemClockWrapper/0x28: 0x5fcf590: when *(rsi+0x20) is null, create the wrapped PosixClock through 0x5fe2680 (unmodeled; it installs the PosixClock vtable 0x64ce930) and store it at +0x20 with shared_ptr refcounting, then call the shared slot-0x28 (0x6095e70).
override_notes.CompositeEnvWrapper/0x28: 0x5fd7560 (MockEnv's slot 0x28; CompositeEnvWrapper shares the MockEnv override): when *(rsi+0x50) is null, take *(rsi+0x48), creating the wrapped PosixEnv through 0x5fe2860 (unmodeled; installs the PosixEnv vtable 0x64cea10) when that is null too; when *(rsi+0x28) is null, create it through 0x5fcf390 (unmodeled); when *(rsi+0x38) is null, create it through 0x5fcf430 (unmodeled) applied to the wrapped env; then call the shared slot-0x28 (0x6095e70).
override_notes.ConfigurableCFOptions/0x38: 0x607dd50: compare the input name against the .bss string at 0x6506ac0 (runtime-built; its value is not recoverable from the static binary); on a match return this+0x330, else tail-jump to the shared resolver 0x60958c0 (linear scan over the 0x30-byte record array, returns the matching record's +0x20 field).
override_notes.DBOptionsConfigurable/0x38: 0x60a0240: the DBOptions variant: compare the input name against the .bss string at 0x6506d60 (runtime-built); on a match return this+0x2d8 (the start of the DBOptions snapshot block that slot 0x48 copies into), else tail-jump to the shared resolver 0x60958c0.
override_notes.ConfigurableMutableCFOptions/0x48: 0x607e420: call host A (0x609d0e0); return early when its Status is non-zero; call 0x60c0580 (unmodeled) with (this+0x20, this+0x330) and 0x60c2a10 (unmodeled) with (this+0x218, this+0x330); then call the delegate's slot 0x28 and copy its Status out.
override_notes.DBOptionsConfigurable/0x48: 0x60a2470: call host A (0x609d0e0); return early when its Status is non-zero; read the DBOptions snapshot through 0x60c2e20 (unmodeled) into a local struct and copy it field-by-field into this+0x2d8..+0x560 (shared_ptr refcount management, old vector<string> teardown at +0x348); call finalize helper 0x5d354b0 (unmodeled); then call the delegate's slot 0x28 and copy its Status out.
override_notes.ConfigurableCFOptions/0x58: 0x6086b70 (twin A) and 0x60a7420 (twin B, MutableDBConfigurable): byte-identical after address normalization except the holder-map loads (0x630 vs 0x90); see RE-001-default-name-115 (#3563).
override_notes.SystemClockWrapper/0x60: 0x5fcdae0: run the shared slot-0x60 (0x609de80); then, when the value kind (+0x28) is not 1 and a wrapped clock is installed at +0x20, check whether the wrapped clock's IsInstanceOf (slot 0x80) is the canonical 0x5d2e770 (GOT 0x64eceb8) and whether its Name() / NickName() (slots 0x70/0x90) equal "DefaultClock"; when the wrapped clock is not the default clock, append "target=" (0x4496d1) + the wrapped clock's serialization (helpers 0x5fcd890/0x5fcd6f0/0x61d13e0/0x61d1390/0x60971c0, unmodeled).
override_notes.CompositeEnvWrapper/0x60: 0x5fd5e00 (MockEnv's slot 0x60): run the shared slot-0x60 (0x609de80); then, when the wrapped PosixEnv at +0x48 is non-null and differs from the default PosixEnv returned by 0x5fe2860 (unmodeled), append "target=" (0x4496d1) + the wrapped env's serialization (helpers 0x5fd5cc0/0x60971c0, unmodeled).
override_notes.Logger/0x10: 0x5fcc410: a one-shot gate shared by EnvLogger, TestMemLogger and AutoRollLogger: when *(rsi+0x10) is 0, set it to 1 and call the delegate's slot 0x50; later calls write a zeroed Status into *(rdi) and return. TestMemLogger's slot 0x50 (0x5fcc480) returns Status code 3 (kNotSupported).
override_notes.Configurable/0x10: 0x6099030: resolve the option name through the delegate's slot 0x68 (dotted-name lookup) into a local string, then call worker 0x6098ad0 (unmodeled) and return its Status.
override_notes.Configurable/0x18: 0x60996a0: the Configurable configure worker; the Env slot-0x18 (0x609dc40) tail-jumps here after its name check. The worker's own callee 0x6099100 is unmodeled.
override_notes.Configurable/0x60: 0x60985e0: initialize a 16-byte struct at rdi, then call worker 0x6097630 (unmodeled) over the object; the shared slot-0x60 forwards here when the value kind is not 1 and the delegate name is non-empty.
override_notes.Configurable/0x68: 0x6095a60: a std::string copy (SSO-aware) of the string at *(rdx) into the string at this; the shared slot-0x68 falls back here when the input name does not start with the delegate's Name() + '.'.

sites.meaning: delegate IsInstanceOf must be the canonical 0x5d2e770
delegate_impl calls the delegate's slot 0x48 (merge host)

find_entry_dispatch.note: The create host passes *(rbp) as find_entry's delegate, where rbp is its 4th argument (rcx): a shared_ptr<Statistics> holder whose +0x00 is the Statistics*. StatisticsImpl is the only delegate class whose slot-0x88 reads +0x28, matching the matcher node's +0x28 delegate pointer.

install_sites_note: Only 6 of the 19 family classes have lea install sites anywhere in this binary (PosixEnv 3, PosixClock 1, PosixFileSystem 5, TestMemLogger 4, MockEnvDirectory 1, MockEnvFileLock 3; the FileSystem trio is counted in the census but is not part of the 19-table delegate family). The other family vtable bases never appear as an instruction operand and no relocation holds them as a value: their objects are not constructed by any code in this binary, so the delegate objects find_entry dispatches on arrive through construction paths outside this binary's .text. See README.md open unknowns.
open_unknowns: Which construction paths install a non-null +0x28 delegate on the matcher node: MockEnv's slot 0x28 lazily creates +0x28 via 0x5fcf390 and +0x38 via 0x5fcf430, and SCW's slot 0x28 lazily creates its wrapped PosixClock via 0x5fe2680, but the creators' bodies (0x5fcf390, 0x5fcf430, 0x5fe2680, 0x5fe2860) are not in this packet.

SystemClockWrapper's slot 0x70 (Name) is NULL: calling Name() on a SystemClockWrapper would crash; the binary never does (find_entry calls slot 0x78 on the delegate, which calls slot 0x70 only on the wrapped object).
The Configurable configure worker's callee 0x6099100 (tail-jumped to by conf_slot18) is not in this packet.
The slot-0x58 kind validators 0x60bf980 and 0x60bf7c0 are not in this packet.

The slot-0x28/0x30 workers 0x60b9e00 and 0x60b9f50, the slot-0x50 worker 0x60bedc0 and reporter 0x61cf670, the slot-0x60 worker 0x6097630, the Configurable slot-0x10 worker 0x6098ad0, and the slot-0x60 append helpers 0x5fcd890/0x5fcd6f0/0x61d13e0/0x61d1390/0x60971c0/0x5fd5cc0 are not in this packet.

StatisticsImpl's +0x28 field (read by its slot 0x88) and the .bss string at 0x6506ac0 (compared by ConfigurableCFOptions' slot 0x38) are runtime-built; their values are not recoverable from the static binary.

The Logger-family method bodies (EnvLogger/AutoRollLogger slots 0x18..0x50, TestMemLogger slots 0x18/0x20/0x38, MockEnvDirectory slots 0x10/0x18/0x28) belong to the Logger/Directory interfaces, not the Customizable delegate interface, and are not excerpted here.
The 85-slot Env-family tables have Env-specific slots at 0xa0..0x2a0 (file IO and friends) outside the delegate interface; they are listed in vtables.tsv but not given contracts here.
